basic_details.short_information: Chittaranjan Locomotive Works (CLW) has released the official Contract Medical Practitioner (Specialist) Notification 2026. A total of 2 vacancies have been announced under the CLW Contract Medical Practitioner (Specialist) Recruitment 2026. Eligible candidates with an entry-level age not exceeding 60 years as on 31.07.2026 and holding an MBBS degree with a Post Graduate Degree/Diploma in the respective specialty recognized by MCI along with a valid Registration Certificate issued by any State Medical Council/Medical Council of India can attend the walk-in interview on 25 August 2026. content_sections.heading: CLW Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the CLW Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download CLW Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form (Annexure 'A') with one of the two photographs pasted. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for CLW Recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Contract Medical Practitioner (Specialist) posts at Chittaranjan Locomotive Works (CLW) is scheduled for 25 August 2026. Candidates should ensure they are present at the venue on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Contract Medical Practitioner (Specialist) post?
faq.answer: The required qualification is MBBS with a Post Graduate Degree/Diploma in the respective field of specialty recognized by MCI, along with a valid Registration Certificate from any State Medical Council or the Medical Council of India.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for applying to this CLW recruitment?
faq.answer: The entry-level age should not exceed 60 years as of 31.07.2026. For retired Railway/Government Doctors, the maximum age limit is 67 years or 07 terms, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Contract Medical Practitioner (Specialist) position?
faq.answer: The monthly remuneration for a Specialist is Rs.1,23,500/-. For retired doctors, the total remuneration plus pension should not exceed their last pay drawn at retirement.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Contract Medical Practitioner (Specialist) post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for the Contract Medical Practitioner (Specialist) posts. These are for CMP(Specialist) – ENT and CMP(Specialist) – Medicine.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the walk-in interview at the specified venue and time with all required documents.

faq.question: Q7. Where is the walk-in interview for CLW Recruitment 2026 going to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at the Office of the Principal Chief Medical Officer, Kasturba Gandhi Hospital, Chittaranjan, 713331, West Bengal.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should candidates bring for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring all original certificates and attested copies in support of age, qualification, experience, etc., along with two passport-size photographs and a duly filled application form.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for this CLW recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification released by Chittaranjan Locomotive Works (CLW) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q10. What is the nature of the employment for these posts?
faq.answer: The engagement for the Contract Medical Practitioner (Specialist) posts is on a full-time contract basis for a duration of one year.
